title: Recursion Pharmaceuticals Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At March 31, 2026, Recursion reported USD 654.5 million cash and cash equivalents, 530.6 million shares outstanding, a USD 117.5 million quarterly net loss, and stated that additional capital will be required to advance drug candidates.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supports current clinical-stage economics, cash runway, operating losses, dilution, capital-needs, and valuation-risk analysis; SEC submissions showed no later Form 10-Q through 2026-07-27.
